breakPlan.title: Between-Games Rhythm
breakPlan.intro: Saturday is an 8:00 AM and 11:45 AM double, both at Dutch Fork High School. That is a short turnaround — about 1 hour 55 minutes between the final whistle and the next report time, so plan to stay on site.

steps.label: Eat immediately
steps.note: Eat within 30 minutes of the whistle. Bring it with you — there is no time to drive out and back comfortably.

steps.label: Shade + change
steps.note: Dry shirt, dry socks, hat off and hydrate. The morning is the coolest part of the day, so use it.

steps.label: Quiet sit
steps.note: Feet up in the car or in the shade. No running around between games.

steps.label: Back for game #734
steps.note: Field B. Ten minutes of passing, then check in with the coach.
